selector.rationale: The presence of a soft tissue mass with increased vascularity surrounding the device, along with the exclusion of haematoma or infection, supports the diagnosis of a pacemaker pocket tumor. The patient's history of cancer also makes metastatic disease a consideration, but the specific findings around the pacemaker site lean towards a primary tumor at the site.

rejected.label: Lymphoma
rejected.why: The specific findings around the pacemaker site do not strongly support lymphoma, and the exclusion of infection reduces the likelihood of lymphoma being related to the COVID-19 infection

rejected.label: Sarcoma
rejected.why: While sarcoma could explain the soft tissue mass, the history of other cancers and the specific location of the mass make pacemaker pocket tumor or metastatic disease more likely explanations
